(Currently Amended) 1. An apparatus, comprising: an encoder (300) for encoding mode mapping information for a mapping between values of a mode index and modes available to encode at least a portion of a picture in a sequence of pictures, wherein the mode mapping information is adapted and modified responsive to one or more actual parameters of the sequence.

(Currently Amended) 5. The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the adapted mode mapping information is signaled using at least one high level syntax element, wherein the high level syntax element is not limited to but may include at least one of a slice header, a sequence parameter set, a picture parameter set, a network abstraction layer unit header, and a supplemental enhancement information message.

(Currently Amended) 31. The method of claim 25, wherein the adapted mode mapping information is updated after decoding one or more pictures of the sequence, and the updating of the adapted mode mapping information occurs after an encoding pass for at least one of the pictures in the sequence. 

(Currently Amended) 33. A computer-readable storage medium having non-transitory video signal data encoded thereupon, comprising: mode mapping information for a mapping between values of a mode index and modes available to encode at least a portion of a picture in a sequence of pictures, wherein the mode mapping information is adapted responsive to one or more actual parameters of the sequence.
